cross_sensor_realsense_d435i_comparison.reference_sensor: Intel RealSense D435i Active-IR Structured Light (848x480)

near_field_d_gt_127_saturation_diagnosti.root_cause: At 4x coarse resolution with D_coarse=32 (0..31 coarse px = 0..124 full-res px), select_output in stereo.slang skips subpixel parabola interpolation when best == 31 (best + 1 < disparities is false), clamping coarse_disparity to exact 31.000 (124.0 px). Full-res match then searches [122, 126] px and admits false matches at d≈124 px where true tabletop disparity is 132..170 px (Z < 0.496 m). Milestone v9.4 strictly isolates y >= 463 as out-of-range (never extrapolating beyond d = 127 px), while Milestone v10.2 evaluates D_coarse = 64 (256 px full-res range) to recover the near-field tabletop.
